sentences.en: I tried vinegar bath once or twice, I don't remember.
sentences.zh: 我试过一两次醋浴，记不太清了。

sentences.en: You can catch more flies with honey than with vinegar.
sentences.zh: 甜言蜜语比恶语更能打动人心。

sentences.en: Did you know that vinegar can be made from dates?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？醋也可以从枣子里酿成的。

senses.zh: 醋,乖戾，尖酸刻薄,<口>充沛的精力
